note.zh-TW: 模板以股本÷每股面額推算股數；「每張股票面額」顯示為「每股面額」，預設可修改。
note.en: The template estimates the number of shares as share capital divided by par value per share; the par value label is corrected and the default can be changed.

definition.zh-TW: 本期淨利分到每一股有多少。數值越高表示每股賺得越多。
definition.en: The profit for the period attributable to each share. Higher means each share earned more.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IAS 33 定義每股盈餘：歸屬於母公司普通股股東的淨利除以加權平均流通在外股數；模板用股本推算股數是簡化。
ifrsNote.en: IAS 33 defines earnings per share as profit attributable to ordinary shareholders of the parent divided by the weighted average number of shares outstanding; estimating the shares from share capital is a template simplification.
